title: pack.toml
description: A brainrc pack's manifest, after it is parsed as TOML (docs/packs.md#packtoml). validate warns on a key not listed here.

name.description: The pack's name; default: its packs.toml table or folder name.

prefix.description: What every skill, agent, command and MCP server name starts with; default: "<name>-" (docs/packs.md#naming).

id.description: The <owner>/<pack> ID the pack is published under (docs/packs.md#naming).

description.description: One line on what the pack is for.

requires_core.description: Core versions the pack works with, e.g. ">=0.8, <0.9" (docs/packs.md#compatibility).

max_always_tokens.description: Budget for the tokens the pack loads into every session: rules plus descriptions (docs/packs.md#context-cost).

validator.description: A Python module in the pack that checks what only it understands (docs/packs.md#validator-plugins).

test.description: The pack's own unittest tests, a directory or a .py file in the pack; validate --pack runs them (docs/packs.md#pack-tests).

extensions.description: Tables other packs read, one per namespace, e.g. [extensions.gatework]; the pack that owns a namespace checks it (docs/packs.md#extensions).
